getSnapshot.semantics: read snapshot then bound event details for controller response

sendMessage.semantics: send once; legacy clients receive a snapshot, negotiated clients may receive acceptance receipt

beginAttachmentUpload.semantics: allocate bounded per-peer in-memory upload; no native call

appendAttachmentUpload.semantics: append bounded chunk to per-peer in-memory upload; no native call

finishAttachmentUpload.semantics: assemble upload then persist through owner bridge

cancelTask.semantics: owner bridge cancellation followed by bounded snapshot

resumeTask.semantics: owner bridge resume followed by bounded snapshot

sendMessage.semantics: check shared scope and compose tagged visitor message before owner bridge send

storeAttachment.semantics: check shared task scope before owner bridge attachment storage
